description: Title in red and black. Includes reprint of t.-p. of original edition, London, 1622. "Edition;--two hundred and fifty copies foolscap quarto. Thirty-five copies royal quarto." No. 68. Usually cited as Mourt's relation on account of the signature of G. Mourt, found at the end of the address to the reader, though it is clear that he did no more than commend the work to the public. There is general agreement that G. Mourt was George Morton, and that the Relation was the work of Bradford and Winslow. Also available in digital form. Exhibited: "E Pluribus Unum: Celebrating the American Experience" at the George H.W.
